match.label: Match total
match.description: {{base}} Match total: both teams added together.

team.label: Team
team.description: {{base}} Team: only those of the team shown on each card.

rival.label: Opponent
rival.description: {{base}} Opponent: those of the other team in each match.

each.label: Each team
each.description: {{base}} Each team: both teams over the line (or, with ‘Under’, both under it).

handicap.label: Handicap
handicap.description: {{base}} Handicap: the line is added to the team's total and compared with the opponent's. ‘-1.5’ = the team gets at least 2 more than the opponent; ‘+1.5’ = the team doesn't end up 2 or more behind the opponent.

cards.label: Cards
cards.description: Cards received (yellow + red); the red square next to the figure indicates a sending-off.

bookingPoints.label: Booking points
bookingPoints.note: Approximate: the source doesn't distinguish a straight red from a second yellow, so every red counts as 25, not 35.

shots.label: Shots
shots.description: Total shots, on target or not.

average.team: team shots on target per match
average.rival: opponent shots on target per match

btts.label: Both teams to score
btts.title: Both teams to score
btts.description: Matches in which both teams scored (or, with ‘No’, in which at least one failed to score).

bttsResult.label: Both score and result
bttsResult.title: Both teams to score and result
bttsResult.description: Matches in which both teams scored and, on top of that, the team won, drew or lost.

goalsByHalf.label: Goals by half
goalsByHalf.title: Goals by half
goalsByHalf.description: First-half and second-half goals, separately. The extra column is the half-time score.

result.label: Result
result.title: Result
result.description: Full-time result of the match from the team's point of view.

htFt.label: Half-time / Full-time
htFt.title: Half-time / Full-time
htFt.description: Result at half-time and at full-time from the team's point of view. ‘Draw / Win’ = level at half-time and went on to win.

cleanSheet.label: Clean sheet
cleanSheet.title: Clean sheet
cleanSheet.description: Matches in which the team didn't concede a goal (or, with ‘No’, in which they conceded at least one).

cornerDuel.label: Corner count
cornerDuel.title: Corner count
cornerDuel.description: Whether the team takes more corners than their opponent in the match.

redCards.label: Red cards
redCards.title: Red cards in the match
redCards.description: Matches with at least one red card (for either team), with none, or with two or more.
redCards.note: The source doesn't distinguish a straight red from a second yellow: both count.

page.refereesLead: How each referee's matches play out: cards, booking points, red cards, corners or goals. Full-match markets only, which don't depend on which team is at home.
page.leagueRate: League average in {{season}}: <bold>{{pct}}</bold> of matches ({{hits}} of {{total}}).
page.leagueRateAverage: League average in {{season}}: <bold>{{pct}}</bold> of matches ({{hits}} of {{total}}) · {{average}} {{label}}.
page.withoutReferee_one: {{count}} match in {{season}} has no referee in the data sources and doesn't count for any referee: referees' figures may be incomplete.
page.withoutReferee_other: {{count}} matches in {{season}} have no referee in the data sources and don't count for any referee: referees' figures may be incomplete.
page.noRefereeData: No referee data for this league in {{season}}. Outside the Premier League, referees come from ESPN, which doesn't have them before 21/22.
page.noMatches: No matches played for this league and season.

noSearchMatch.team: No team in this league matches ‘{{query}}’. Try another league.
noSearchMatch.referee: No referee in this league matches ‘{{query}}’. Try another league.

pickAnother.team: Select another team to compare it with {{name}}.
pickAnother.referee: Select another referee to compare them with {{name}}.

legend.missing: Grey: the match has no data for this and doesn't count towards the percentage.

lowSample.team: With fewer than {{n}} matches, a team's percentage is shown faded: it's unreliable, so treat it as a rough guide.
lowSample.referee: With fewer than {{n}} matches, a referee's percentage is shown faded: it's unreliable, so treat it as a rough guide.

nextCompare.empty: No matches left to play in this league.
nextCompare.hint: Pick a match to compare its two teams.

domestic.title: See in their league
domestic.none: We don't have their league in our data, or they haven't played any league matches this season yet.
